name: XTDB Open-Source Bitemporal SQL Database
free_limit: MPL-2.0 licensed, free-to-use SQL database with immutable history and bitemporal queries; run a self-managed Docker deployment without a vendor software subscription.
watch_out: Bring your own CPU, memory, persistent storage or S3-compatible object storage, networking and operations. Managed infrastructure and optional commercial support or consulting are not included; MPL-2.0 distribution obligations apply.
